name: open_integrator_todo
title: Open a todo for the integrator
description: Queue a todo for the owner's connected client: anything it can do on the owner's machine or with the owner's accounts (an install, a setting, an email, a calendar). The question field holds why it is needed. The answer comes back to you. A decision is not a todo: use ask_human.

task_key.description: A card projectman already follows (an open or handed-over obligation) is refused with obligation_tracked: projectman hands that step over itself.
